expectations.evidence: Review quotes three anti-patterns with draft text: 'Phase 1 log review, Phase 2 trace inspection' (invented process), 'definitely the root cause' (overclaim), and 'Production is fixed and ready' / ✅ plus closing 'the incident is resolved' (false resolution claim).

Rewrite opens with 'Trace sampling turned up a likely cause' (recovery/status) and immediately notes 'Only 7 of the 312 failed requests were traced, and other failure mechanisms haven't been ruled out' (unproven root cause), not process narration.
Rewrite uses 'likely cause', 'leading hypothesis', 'unconfirmed root cause', and 'not yet confirmed as the sole or complete cause' — never repeats 'definitely'.
Rewrite states exactly: 'Only 7 of the 312 failed requests were traced, and other failure mechanisms haven't been ruled out.'

Rewrite preserves 'The recommendations feature flag was disabled at 16:42 UTC' and 'A rollback was considered but not performed, since release v4.8 also contains a security patch — disabling the flag removed the failing path without removing that patch.'
Rewrite includes 'All 418 unit tests and the 6 new targeted regression tests pass; the full integration suite has not yet run.'
Rewrite states: 'Open decision: backport the cache-key fix to v4.8, or wait for v4.9. Recommendation: backport tomorrow, once the full integration suite passes.'
Every number traces to fixture: 7/312, 418 unit, 6 regression, 16:42 UTC, 16:47 UTC. No extra estimates or invented counts.

Rewrite describes only the fixture's mechanism (cache key omits tenant ID → shared entry) without adding new failure paths, impact expansions, or certainty claims; no unverified mechanisms introduced.

The 'Cut as selection' section lists removed material (Phase 1/2/3 narration, 'definitely', ✅/resolved recap, first-person tone) and explicitly notes the missing caveat was restored ('with the missing caveat ... restored'), not that facts/caveats were removed.
